skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Life Appraiser
skins.content: 0011 Tempest Series/The Life Appraiser. Traditional clothes made for an appraiser of all things. A purple cape patterned with gold is paired with roomy trousers, emphasizing the wearer's easy-going yet profound nature.
skins.quote: Hands fiddle with relics unending, eyes rove across mortality shifting. What stories would these treasures tell him if they could speak?

skins.name: Trust Your Eyes
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'The Curious Trove Manor' Custom Line/Trust Your Eyes. The actor plays the role of a Great Thief Magician, here for the treasure. No, come now—doubt those eyes of yours. Trust his hands.
skins.quote: Lee deftly handles his playing cards, corner of his mouth cocked in the same smile as ever. 'Winning a commitment from the underworld three times over in one card game? Ah, that's nonsense.'

skins.name: Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha. Hard to imagine, but the oft-lazing-about Lee is happily wearing an apron while minding the leung cha store below the office. A hobby of his?
skins.quote: A leung cha store is not just for leung cha, and the office is not just for work. As Lee would say, this is where you'll find the human touch in Lungmen. After all, no matter if someone's here for leung cha or a detective, what they're really looking for is peace of mind.
